regionSource: BC Data Catalogue - ABMS regional districts and municipalities, Open Government Licence - British Columbia

basins.label: Greater Victoria
basins.note: Victoria, Saanich, Oak Bay, Esquimalt, View Royal, Sidney and the Saanich Peninsula.

basins.label: West Shore & Sooke
basins.note: Langford, Colwood, Metchosin, Highlands, and out Highway 14 to Port Renfrew.

basins.label: Southern Gulf Islands
basins.note: Salt Spring, Pender, Mayne, Galiano, Saturna, Thetis. Every job is a sailing, and hopping between islands is often two.

basins.label: Cowichan Valley
basins.note: Over the Malahat from Victoria: Duncan, North Cowichan, Chemainus, Ladysmith, Lake Cowichan.

basins.label: Nanaimo & Area
basins.note: Nanaimo, Lantzville, Cedar, South Wellington. Gabriola is a sailing off the harbour.

basins.label: Parksville–Qualicum
basins.note: Parksville, Qualicum Beach, Errington, Coombs, Bowser, Deep Bay.

basins.label: Port Alberni Valley
basins.note: Over the Alberni Summit on Highway 4: Port Alberni, Sproat Lake, Beaver Creek, Bamfield.

basins.label: Tofino–Ucluelet
basins.note: Past Sutton Pass and another two hours: Tofino, Ucluelet, Hitacu, Esowista, Macoah.

basins.label: Comox Valley
basins.note: Courtenay, Comox, Cumberland, Royston, Merville, Black Creek, Union Bay.

basins.label: Campbell River & Area
basins.note: Campbell River, Campbellton, Quinsam, Sayward, Woss. Quadra and Cortes are sailings.

basins.label: Gold River, Tahsis & Zeballos
basins.note: Over the island spine on Highway 28, then gravel to Tahsis and Zeballos.

basins.label: North Island
basins.note: Port Hardy, Port McNeill, Port Alice, Coal Harbour, Holberg, Winter Harbour. Alert Bay, Sointula and the Broughton inlets are boat trips.

basins.label: Lower Sunshine Coast
basins.note: Gibsons, Roberts Creek, Sechelt, Davis Bay, Halfmoon Bay. Forty minutes from Horseshoe Bay, and no road around.

basins.label: Pender Harbour & Egmont
basins.note: Madeira Park, Garden Bay, Egmont, Earls Cove — an hour beyond Sechelt.

basins.label: qathet / Powell River
basins.note: Powell River, Westview, Lund, Saltery Bay. Two ferries from Vancouver; Texada is a third.

basins.label: Vancouver & Burnaby
basins.note: Vancouver, Burnaby, New Westminster, Musqueam.

basins.label: North Shore
basins.note: City and District of North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Lions Bay. Bowen Island is a sailing from Horseshoe Bay.

basins.label: Richmond & Delta
basins.note: Richmond, Delta, Ladner, Tsawwassen, Steveston.

basins.label: Surrey, White Rock & Langley
basins.note: Surrey, White Rock, City and Township of Langley, Cloverdale, Semiahmoo.

basins.label: Tri-Cities & Ridge Meadows
basins.note: Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Anmore, Belcarra, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows.

basins.label: Abbotsford & Mission
basins.note: Abbotsford, Mission, Matsqui, Sumas Prairie, Deroche.

basins.label: Chilliwack & Agassiz
basins.note: Chilliwack, Sardis, Agassiz, Harrison Hot Springs, Cultus Lake, Rosedale.

basins.label: Hope & the Fraser Canyon
basins.note: Hope, Yale, Spuzzum, Boston Bar, North Bend.

basins.label: Squamish & Howe Sound
basins.note: Squamish, Brackendale, Britannia Beach, Furry Creek, Garibaldi Highlands.

basins.label: Whistler & Pemberton
basins.note: Whistler, Pemberton, Mount Currie, Birken, D'Arcy.

basins.label: Lillooet & Bridge River
basins.note: Over the Duffey Lake road from Pemberton, or up from Cache Creek. The Duffey closes in winter.

basins.label: Kamloops & Area
basins.note: Kamloops, Chase, Savona, Pritchard, Logan Lake, Sun Peaks, Tk'emlúps.

basins.label: Merritt & the Nicola Valley
basins.note: Over the Coquihalla from either end: Merritt, Lower Nicola, Douglas Lake, Shulus.

basins.label: Cache Creek, Ashcroft & Clinton
basins.note: The Highway 97 junction: Cache Creek, Ashcroft, Clinton, Spences Bridge, 70 Mile House.

basins.label: North Thompson
basins.note: Barriere, Clearwater, Vavenby, Blue River, Avola.

basins.label: Lytton & the Thompson Canyon
basins.note: Lytton, the Lytton First Nation reserves, Botanie, Stein, Kanaka Bar.

basins.label: Shuswap
basins.note: Salmon Arm, Sicamous, Sorrento, Blind Bay, Tappen, Malakwa.

basins.label: Central Okanagan
basins.note: Kelowna, West Kelowna, Lake Country, Peachland, Westbank, Winfield.

basins.label: North Okanagan
basins.note: Vernon, Coldstream, Armstrong, Spallumcheen, Enderby, Lumby, Falkland.

basins.label: South Okanagan
basins.note: Penticton, Summerland, Naramata, Okanagan Falls, Kaleden.

basins.label: Oliver, Osoyoos & Keremeos
basins.note: Oliver, Osoyoos, Keremeos, Cawston, the south valley.

basins.label: Similkameen
basins.note: Over Allison Pass from Hope: Princeton, Tulameen, Coalmont, Hedley.

basins.label: Nelson & the Slocan
basins.note: Nelson, Salmo, Slocan, Silverton, New Denver, Kaslo, Balfour, Ymir.

basins.label: Trail, Castlegar & Rossland
basins.note: One labour market across two regional districts: Trail, Castlegar, Rossland, Fruitvale, Warfield, Montrose.

basins.label: Creston Valley
basins.note: Over the Kootenay Pass from Salmo, or across on the Kootenay Lake ferry.

basins.label: Arrow Lakes
basins.note: The Needles and Galena Bay cable ferries reach it from every direction.

basins.label: Boundary
basins.note: Over the Paulson and Eholt summits: Grand Forks, Greenwood, Midway, Christina Lake, Beaverdell.

basins.label: Cranbrook & Kimberley
basins.note: Cranbrook, Kimberley, Marysville, Wardner, Moyie, ʔaq'am.

basins.label: Elk Valley
basins.note: Fernie, Sparwood, Elkford, Hosmer, Jaffray.

basins.label: Columbia Valley
basins.note: Invermere, Radium Hot Springs, Canal Flats, Fairmont Hot Springs, Windermere.

basins.label: Golden & Kicking Horse
basins.note: Rogers Pass one way, Kicking Horse the other, and both close for avalanche control.

basins.label: Revelstoke
basins.note: Between Eagle Pass and Rogers Pass, with nothing for an hour in either direction.

basins.label: Williams Lake & Area
basins.note: Williams Lake, Sugarcane, 150 Mile House, Horsefly, Likely, Soda Creek, McLeese Lake.

basins.label: Quesnel & Area
basins.note: Quesnel, Bouchie Lake, Nazko, Wells, Barkerville, Hixon's south end.

basins.label: South Cariboo
basins.note: 100 Mile House, Lac la Hache, Bridge Lake, Canim Lake, Forest Grove.

basins.label: Chilcotin
basins.note: Highway 20 west of the Fraser: Alexis Creek, Redstone, Tatla Lake, Nemiah, Chilanko Forks.

basins.label: West Chilcotin
basins.note: Anahim Lake, Ulkatcho, Nimpo Lake, Towdystan, Kleena Kleene — another two hours past Alexis Creek.

basins.label: Bella Coola Valley
basins.note: Down the Heckman Pass switchbacks from the Chilcotin, or in on the ferry.

basins.label: Central Coast (Bella Bella & Klemtu)
basins.note: Bella Bella, Klemtu, Ocean Falls, Shearwater, Namu. Ferry or float plane, and a separate trip to each.

basins.label: Prince Rupert & the North Coast
basins.note: Prince Rupert, Port Edward, Lax Kw'alaams, Metlakatla, Kitkatla.

basins.label: Haida Gwaii
basins.note: Old Massett, Port Clements, Tlell, Skidegate, Daajing Giids, Sandspit. Seven hours on the Skeena, or a flight.

basins.label: Terrace & Kitimat
basins.note: Terrace, Kitimat, Thornhill, Kitamaat Village, Kitselas, Kitsumkalum.

basins.label: The Hazeltons
basins.note: New Hazelton, Hazelton, South Hazelton, Kispiox, Gitanmaax, Gitsegukla, Gitwangak.

basins.label: Nass Valley
basins.note: Gitlaxt'aamiks, Gitwinksihlkw, Laxgalts'ap, Gingolx, Nass Camp.

basins.label: Stewart & the Bear Valley
basins.note: Highway 37A over Bear Pass: 65 km from the junction with nothing in between.

basins.label: Bulkley Valley
basins.note: Smithers, Telkwa, Houston, Witset, Quick, Topley.

basins.label: Lakes District
basins.note: Burns Lake, Southside, Francois Lake, Granisle, Decker Lake.

basins.label: Nechako
basins.note: Vanderhoof, Fort Fraser, Fraser Lake, Endako, Stoney Creek.

basins.label: Fort St. James & Stuart Lake
basins.note: Fort St. James, Nak'azdli, Tachie, Middle River, and the Takla and Sustut country beyond the road.

basins.label: Dease Lake & the Stikine
basins.note: Highway 37 north: Dease Lake, Iskut, Telegraph Creek, Good Hope Lake, Jade City.

basins.label: Atlin & the Far Northwest
basins.note: Reached through the Yukon: ninety minutes from Whitehorse, two days from Vancouver.

basins.label: Prince George & Area
basins.note: Prince George, Beaverley, Pineview, Shelley, Hixon, Bear Lake.

basins.label: Mackenzie
basins.note: Mackenzie, McLeod Lake, Parsnip, and the south end of Williston Reservoir.

basins.label: Williston & the Rocky Mountain Trench
basins.note: Tsay Keh Dene, Kwadacha/Fort Ware, Ingenika. Two hundred kilometres of resource road north of Mackenzie, or a flight.

basins.label: Robson Valley
basins.note: Valemount, McBride, Dunster, Tête Jaune Cache, over the Yellowhead.

basins.label: Dawson Creek & the South Peace
basins.note: Dawson Creek, Pouce Coupe, Rolla, Tomslake, Arras, Farmington.

basins.label: Fort St. John & the North Peace
basins.note: Fort St. John, Taylor, Hudson's Hope, Charlie Lake, Baldonnel, Cecil Lake.

basins.label: Chetwynd & Tumbler Ridge
basins.note: Over the Pine Pass from Prince George: Chetwynd, Tumbler Ridge, Moberly Lake, Jackfish.

basins.label: Alaska Highway North
basins.note: Wonowon, Pink Mountain, Sikanni Chief, Buckinghorse River, Trutch and the Beatton ranches.

basins.label: Fort Nelson
basins.note: Fort Nelson, Prophet River, Fontas, Kahntah, and the Northern Rockies municipality.

basins.label: Liard & the Northern Rockies Highway
basins.note: Summit Lake, Toad River, Muncho Lake, Liard River, Coal River, Fireside, Lower Post. Four hundred kilometres of Alaska Highway to Watson Lake.
